wiki_text: ADNOC awarded the main EPC contract for Ruwais LNG (a joint venture led by Technip Energies with JGC Corporation and NMDC Energy, ~$5.5bn) around the June 2024 FID. In January 2025, CB&I was awarded a separate lump-sum EPC package (reported around $0.5bn) for tankage/storage scope. NMDC Group is carrying out a large-scale dredging package (~15 million cubic metres across a ~5km channel) to enable marine access. The facility is designed to run on grid electricity from nuclear and renewable sources, positioned as the first LNG export facility in the MENA region to run on clean power. No slippage to the 2028 (T1) / 2029 (T2) startup schedule has been reported as of mid-2026.
